D: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create an original believable editorial photograph for SundaySeeds, a Bible learning app. Alternative D: prayer as an ordinary human moment. A young East African man in his late twenties sits quietly by the open doorway of a modest home early in the morning, elbows resting on his knees, hands loosely clasped, eyes gently closed in private prayer. He wears an ordinary faded charcoal cotton shirt and trousers, no religious costume. An open small Bible rests next to him on a simple wooden stool, slightly out of focus. Unposed candid three-quarter side portrait, no looking at camera, no melodramatic gesture. Natural skin pores, short slightly uneven hair, realistic knuckles and fingernails, believable anatomy, creased worn clothing and subtle scuffs on doorframe. Overcast morning daylight with softly shaded face; ordinary muted natural colors and lifelike exposure, not an imposed palette. Captured on a full-frame camera, 50mm lens, f/4, subtle photographic grain. Portrait 3:4, entire head and hands visible in central safe area, breathing room, uncluttered surroundings. Calm, reflective and grounded. No illustration, no painted effects, no artificial glossy skin, no magical rays, no theatrical lighting or fake fog, no elaborate church ornaments, no text overlay, no logo, no watermark. This must feel like a real photograph from a thoughtful human-interest story.
E: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Alternative E: quiet courage, a grounded live-action biblical period-film photograph for SundaySeeds. A young adult Levantine shepherd stands on a rocky hillside, calmly looking out toward a broad distant valley. A simple leather sling hangs loosely from one hand; the other hand holds a single smooth river stone beside his hip. No battle, no giant, no armor, no threatening pose, no injuries. A small distant sheep on the hillside anchors his ordinary shepherd life. Worn simple oatmeal linen tunic and rough brown wool shoulder wrap, dusty sandals, believable historically inspired practical clothing, not theatrical costumes. Short curly dark hair, sun-weathered brown skin with natural texture, ordinary unidealized face, realistic anatomy and relaxed hands. Thoughtful expression, a little uncertainty and courage rather than heroic posturing. Soft cloudy morning light, muted real grass and limestone tones, lifelike shadows, no magical glow or halos. Shot on a full-frame cinema camera with 50mm lens f/5.6, restrained photographic grain, documentary realism. Portrait 3:4, full head and hands inside frame, subject central with comfortable breathing room. No illustration, no painting, no digital-art appearance, no glossy skin or hyper-sharp artificial detail, no dramatic CGI sky, no forced pastel palette, no text, logos, frames or watermark. Make it look like an honest set photograph from a carefully made historical film.
